findings.observation: The chibi remains recognizably Quinon: the same band-3 adult masculine face, heart-shaped taper, deep-set eyes, heavy level brow, short rounded nose, wide closed mouth, faint freckles, and calm age cues are preserved.

The summon’s very-tall conditioned silhouette is not preserved strongly enough: shoulders and torso are proportionally broadened, and the result reads compact-stocky rather than tall, upright, functionally toned, and non-bulky.

Both sleeves, forearms, wrists, and clenched empty hands are coherent and anatomically complete, but their widths are visibly inflated relative to the accepted summon, especially the lowered right forearm/hand and shoulder-to-arm mass.
The blonde-gold bob/pageboy preserves the source’s layered front and side silhouette, ornate maintained mass, and sharply stepped fringe.

The teal-brown asymmetric patchwork, broad folded collar, crossing repaired panels, visible stitches, small palette repeats, uneven divided hems, practical trousers, and plain shoes remain source-faithful. The map roll is appropriately omitted for two empty combat hands, and no accessory or tattoo is invented.

Original-resolution measurement places the complete hair-to-chin unit at about 29% of standing height, approximately 3.4 heads tall. This falls below the locked 32–36% head share and outside the required 2.75–3.1-head range.
Exactly one coherent full-body subject appears; the complete hair, head, both empty hands, all garment edges, both feet, and soft grounding shadow stay inside clear safe margins.
The grounded staggered stance, separated empty fists, forward-ready torso, and uncluttered silhouette read clearly as a weaponless ready-idle at combat-icon scale.

The character remains ordinary repaired cloth and practical footwear with no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect.
